suite.name: formal_controls_kvasir_v1
suite.purpose: Control experiments requested by an external review of the study. All arms are trained on this PC with the same three seeds, so that every comparison in this suite is between models trained on the same hardware.
suite.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image

arm_notes.detail: accepted detail-branch recipe, retrained here as the same-hardware reference
arm_notes.baseline: accepted fixed-sentence baseline recipe (paired reflection, corrected Dice), retrained here as reference
arm_notes.orig_fixed: original training recipe (one view per step, rotation only, Dice computed as in the public code) with the fixed sentence
arm_notes.orig_fixed_dice: orig_fixed with the corrected Dice term only
arm_notes.flip: orig_fixed_dice plus an ordinary random flip; each sample is flipped with probability 0.5 along a random axis
arm_notes.detail_scale: detail plus ordinary random scaling of the training images
arm_notes.detail_up224: detail branch fed with the 224 image upsampled to 448 (same capacity, no additional image information)

scale_augmentation.scale: log-uniform in [0.5, 2.0], drawn per training sample
scale_augmentation.translation: uniform in [-0.1, 0.1] of the image side, per axis
scale_augmentation.applied_to: 224 image, 448 detail image and mask with identical parameters; training split only

suite.hyperparameters: identical to formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v1 except where an arm says otherwise

reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.statistic: mean over seeds of paired DSC differences, percentage points; macro mean over the four OOD sets

two_pass_after_scale_augmentation.retained: macro OOD gain at least 1.0 pp and positive for every seed
two_pass_after_scale_augmentation.reduced: macro OOD gain between 0.5 and 1.0 pp, or at least 1.0 pp but not positive for every seed

detail_information.supported: macro gain over all five sets above 0 and positive for at least two of three seeds

reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.note: every other contrast is reported with its interval and is descriptive

disclosures: The five polyp test sets were used in earlier stages of this project.
CVC-300 and CVC-ColonDB share 52 exact image hashes.
The single-view arms use half the forward and backward passes per optimisation step of the paired arms.
